episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: In hopes of getting discovered as a singer, Seo Mok-ha recruits Jung Ki-ho to film a video. But as terror strikes both of them, they flee for a new life.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: After a fortuitous rescue, Mok-ha reenters society with a little aid from Kang Woo-hak. Later, Mok-ha gets the chance to help her idol, Yoon Ran-joo.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Ran-joo gets closer to Mok-ha — even getting her a chance to audition. But when the meeting doesn't go in their favor, Mok-ha devises another idea.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Ran-joo performs on a television program, a singing competition with her past self. Mok-ha tries to get a message out to Ki-ho, hoping he's listening.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: After Mok-ha's frightening encounter with Ki-ho's father, Woo-hak begins investigating him. Mok-ha and Ran-joo get a chance to share the stage together.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Woo-hak learns the truth about his past from Kang Bo-geol. Mok-ha confronts Eun Mo-rae, the idol she could have been had she not been stranded.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: During a television program, Ran-joo makes a confession and forces Mok-ha to face off against Mo-rae. A threatening encounter compels Mok-ha to run away.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Bo-geol and Woo-hak retreive Mok-ha and take her on a camping trip with their family. Mok-ha tries to track down Ran-joo to make up for a mistake.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Feeling the imminent threat of his father, Bo-geol confronts him first. After a tense exchange with Ran-joo, Mok-ha signs with RJ Entertainment.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: A scary encounter with Jung Bong-wan leads to Bo-geol's family getting bad press. Ran-joo asks Mok-ha to make a hard choice about her career.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: Ran-joo and Mok-ha receive negative press after meeting with reporters. The Kang family interviews with the prosecutor in their case against Bong-wan.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: Bong-wan executes his final attack on the Kang family. Mok-ha prepares to release her debut song — marking the beginning of her singing career.
